name: @pipeworx/mcp-cfpb

tools.name: cfpb_search_complaints
tools.description: Search consumer complaints by keyword, company, product, or date range. Returns complaint narratives, company responses, and resolution status.

query.description: Search term (e.g., "overdraft fees", "denied claim"). Optional if other filters provided.

company.description: Company name to filter by (e.g., "BANK OF AMERICA", "WELLS FARGO")

product.description: Product category (e.g., "Credit card", "Mortgage", "Student loan", "Vehicle loan or lease", "Checking or savings account", "Credit reporting", "Debt collection")

tools.name: cfpb_company_complaints
tools.description: Get recent complaints against a specific company (e.g., 'Wells Fargo', 'Citibank'). Everyday names are resolved to CFPB's exact registered spelling automatically ("Wells Fargo" -> "WELLS FARGO & COMPANY"), and the response reports which name was actually queried. Returns narratives, company responses, and resolution details sorted newest first.

tools.name: cfpb_get_complaint
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific complaint by ID. Returns narrative, company response, resolution status, and metadata.

tools.name: cfpb_top_companies
tools.description: Find companies with the most complaints in a date range. Returns ranked list with company names and complaint counts.

limit.description: Number of top companies to return (default 10)

tools.name: cfpb_product_breakdown
tools.description: Get complaint counts by product category (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'Mortgage'). Filter by company or date range.

company.description: Optional company name to filter by

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cfpb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cfpb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
